production_source_comparison.interpretation: All executable/config/build sources match the cloud artifact; only listed prior user extensions differ. Later documentation does not change these runtime sources.

visual_review.scope: Six SVI2/SVI3/partial-failure screenshots from Ubuntu 24.04 and Oracle Linux 7.9 inspected at original resolution; final artifact bytes match the inspected preview.

files.observed: SVI2 voltage preserves 1543.75 and 6.25 mV steps; expected currents include 17.5 and 1.75 A. Off-code, reserved-divisor, disabled and reserved-bit rows are distinct. All eight columns and the descriptor/non-measurement explanation are readable.

SVI3 complete VID 256 maps to 1525 mV, VID 511 to 2800 mV, and zero to voltage_off. All rows, raw values and current statuses are visible. The source is explicitly a stored descriptor, not a measured or suggested operating voltage.

P2 read failure clears complete VID, voltage, current, decoded statuses and raw data in that row, while other successful rows remain. Definition status identifies the error and the summary reports one read failure; no stale P2 values are displayed.

limits: P-state VID voltage and expected maximum single-core current are descriptors, not sensor readings, TDP or PBO limits. Only 17h/11h,18h,20h,A0h and 19h/50h are decoded; virtualized CPUs are excluded.
EL7 target is Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64; other RHEL/CentOS 7 configurations have not been certified.
No P-state write or physical hardware acceptance was performed. Other models, including all 1Ah, retain their existing raw fields and frequency decoder.
Windows/macOS test the portable core, not a complete hardware backend.
ICCmax/VR, Vmax/extended TVB, remaining AMD and motherboard controls, and Secure Boot acceptance remain incomplete.
